vacancy.title: Lead Commercial Industrialisation Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A2-A4 role focused on transitioning commercial SatCom hardware to scalable production, DfMA, process automation, production routing, AIT and verification. Strong overlap with TU Delft MSc mechanical engineering and ten years part-time machine design, production and automation (~5 FTE years). Significant stretch: principal technical authority/lead industrialisation responsibility, large-scale satellite/constellation AIT and SatCom industrial experience. ESA states four years relevant professional experience with MSc, but may recruit at A1 if fewer than four years after the master's degree.
